sql.if: AND suspended_at IS NULL AND provision_ceased_at IS NULL

choose.when: SELECT p.id, p.workspace_id, CAST(p.name AS BINARY) AS name, CAST(p.phone AS BINARY) AS phone FROM person p FORCE INDEX (idx_person_workspace)
choose.otherwise: SELECT c.id, c.workspace_id, CAST(c.name AS BINARY) AS name, CAST(c.phone AS BINARY) AS phone FROM company c FORCE INDEX (idx_company_workspace)
